d: An officer needs emergency assistance, a major drug house is raided and a prowler is captured by the K-9 unit.

st: Panama City, FL: Autopsy Of A Marriage
d: Scandal rocks Florida's "Redneck Riviera"--a seaside resort filled with low-priced hotels and bars.

After six members of the DeFeo family are murdered in their home in Amityville, New York, by the oldest DeFeo son, George and Kathy Lutz move into the house and claim to experience a series of bizarre, supernatural events.
Alice receives two life sentences for her role in the slaying of two men. Then, Sarah claims that she made a false murder confession simply to earn a gang status symbol.
A Girl Guide leader is found dead on the floor of her bedroom. When an autopsy reveals a bullet lodged in her brain, detectives learn they’re investigating a murder.
A train passenger behaves oddly en route to Arizona and then disappears. The next day his bloodied body is found in Texas. Dr. G attempts to piece together this bizarre tragedy.
Dario Romano is found dead by his son at the bottom of the attic ladder. What happened to this 45-year-old? With Dr. G’s guidance, Dr. Stephany must solve the mystery.
The saga of popular politician and pharmacist Johnny Volpato, who was accused of shooting his wife to death, then wounding himself to make it appear that someone else had killed her.
When a white off-duty police officer, Amber Guyger, kills an unarmed black man, Botham Jean, in his own home in Dallas, racial tensions and calls for justice rise.
Bored at home, a retiree takes a job at a 24-hour convenience store. On her third night at work a customer finds her behind the register in a pool of blood.
A woman is told by a friend that she was a passenger in a car where she was confronted with a guy's head in a bucket.
July 2000, Vaucluse, a few kilometers from Avignon. Richard Alessandri, 42, a wealthy supermarket owner, is shot dead in his sleep. Everything suggests that it was a home-jacking gone wrong.
On November 20th 2013, a fishermen discovers the corpse of a baby on the beach of Berck.
Hostages are held in a grocery store, police attend a call of shots fired and drug dealers get into a motor vehicle accident.

t: Courage in Red: Customs and Excise (Counter Smuggling)
d: Thanks to collaborative efforts with US and Canadian police; the RCMP is making a difference in stemming the flood of the illicit contraband that funds organized crime across the country.
When a leg bone washes ashore, a forensic pathologist holds the key to the five W’s (who, what, where, when and why) of the mystery.

t: Crimes That Shook Britain: Rochdale Groomers
d: Rochdale Groomers: Documentary examining the sex abuse scandal which occurred in the North of England and appeared to go undetected for quite some time.
The story of debt-ridden mother-of-three and night-time sex worker Beverley James. By day, she was meant to care for Harriet Davison, a frail woman she beat to death.
Police investigate telephone threats, a vehicle stop turns deadly and a burglar is assaulted by a homeowner.

Disguised bandits fell a Brinks guard in Oshawa. The police find a fake bomb in the abandoned getaway car. It is a major forensic clue in tracking the gang. The bandits are charged – but the prosecution needs to find the murder weapon.
Explore the case of Cheryl Lynn Lucas, who shot her husband to death because she believed he was cheating.
On February 26, 2003, garbage bags containing pieces of human bodies were fished out of the Pas-de-Calais on the banks of the Escaut Canal.
